ownership: The host retains challenge identity, exact method, signer selection, relay routing, unlock execution, and pending activation. The application retains a proxy to the existing flow handle. Operation-bound removal and signing proofs use their own internal authorization paths.
flowSemantics: Expired codes fail before unlock requests.
Cancellation before submission retires the flow.
Concurrent submit/resend is rejected. Cancellation while an operation owns the flow rejects.
Failed code submission permits retry until expiry; successful submission ends the flow.

cases.scenario: pending ECDSA activation after reload and original-wallet signing

checks: packed external declarations and isolated core install
limits: Local production assets and managed local gateway. No deployment or publication.
Pending activation evidence covers ECDSA-only response loss; existing mixed NEAR continuation evidence remains separate.
No month-later clock simulation or deployed compression measurement.
